title: Hugo Boss perfume: Bottled, HUGO Man, The Scent and Alive compared
body:
Hugo Boss runs two fragrance lines: BOSS, polished and grown-up, and HUGO, younger and fresher. Most of the range is made for men, with Alive as the women's line. Here is every Hugo Boss perfume we stock, with its notes and who each one suits.

BOSS Bottled Eau de Parfum

Hugo Boss Bottled Eau de Parfum (200ml, for men) opens with apple and a citrus accord, has warm spices in the heart, and settles on woody notes and an earthy accord. Fresh at the start and warm underneath, it is an easy scent for work and evenings, and the large 200ml bottle suits someone who wears it every day.

HUGO Man

HUGO Man Eau de Toilette (125ml) is the fresher, younger choice: green apple and a citrus accord, then herbal notes, over woody notes. Crisp and green, good for daytime, the gym bag and warmer weather.

BOSS The Scent

BOSS The Scent Eau de Toilette (100ml) opens with ginger, mandarin and bergamot, has maninka fruit and lavender in the heart, and finishes on leather. Warm, spicy and smooth, an evening scent. Our listing is a tester.

Alive, for women

The Hugo Boss Alive Eau de Parfum and Body Lotion Gift Set pairs an 80ml eau de parfum with a 75ml body lotion. Alive is built on fruity accords, then floral notes, over woody notes and vanilla accords: a warm, fruity floral, and a ready-made gift.

BOSS The Collection Confident Oud Eau de Parfum Intense (warm spices, an oud accord, amber and woods) is out of stock at present: use Notify me on the page.

Which Hugo Boss perfume should you choose?

  • A warm, versatile scent for him: BOSS Bottled Eau de Parfum.
  • Fresh and green: HUGO Man.
  • Spicy and leathery for evenings: BOSS The Scent.
  • A gift for her: the Alive gift set.

Other men's scents in a similar mood

These are different perfumes, not copies, for anyone who likes the Hugo Boss style:

  • Versace Eros Eau de Toilette (200ml): mint, lemon and candied apple over cedarwood, vetiver and vanilla. Like Bottled, it starts with apple. Our Versace perfume guide has more.
  • Dolce & Gabbana The One for Men Eau de Parfum (100ml): grapefruit, coriander and basil, then cardamom and ginger, over tobacco, amber and cedarwood. See our Dolce & Gabbana perfume guide.
  • Calvin Klein Defy Parfum: mandarin and pink pepper, lavender and a suede accord, over vetiver, amber and woods.
  • Paco Rabanne Invictus Eau de Toilette (200ml): sea notes and grapefruit over guaiac wood and patchouli. See our Paco Rabanne perfume guide.

Good to know

  • Eau de parfum or eau de toilette? Our guide to extrait vs eau de parfum explains the labels.
  • Buying a gift? See our perfume gift sets guide.
  • Every bottle is 100% authentic and dispatched from the UK, with free UK delivery over £40.
